title: feat: adicionado verificacao de duplicidade também para áudio, vídeo e imagem
intent: Extends the duplicate-check feature so it also considers audio, video, and image attachments. A new `build_duplicate_check_query` function extracts a normalized title from the workflow's `FinalAnswerResult` rather than passing the raw query string. The call site in `analyze.py` is moved after the workflow run so the final answer is available when the check executes.

changed_files.summary: Moves duplicate-check call to after workflow completion; replaces raw `query` arg with `build_duplicate_check_query(final_answer)`; passes empty attachments list.
New module: `build_duplicate_check_query` strips classification prefix from `final_answer.title` to produce the normalized search query.
Adds test coverage for the queue path.
Unit tests for `build_duplicate_check_query`: title stripping, None guard, verdict-only title.
Updates worker tests to reflect new call ordering and query-building logic.
